text: Agrokom Group was created in 2004 by Ivan Savvidi; the Rostov businessman is the group's owner.
short: Agrokom Group belongs to Rostov businessman Ivan Savvidi.

source.name: Donnews.ru: Саввиди Иван Игнатьевич (persona page)
source.quote: Бизнесмен, владелец группы «Агроком», входит в список богатейших людей России по версии Forbes
source.note: Page undated; accessed 2026-10-03; the page's news items run to 30 September 2026. Translation: 'Businessman, owner of Agrokom Group, listed among Russia's richest people by Forbes.' The same page says the group was 'Создана в 2004 году Иваном Саввиди' (created in 2004 by Ivan Savvidi) and lists the Atlantis-Pak business complex as part of the group since 2011.
